description: draft-ietf-jmap-mdn-17 §2.1 states: 'When calling this method the using property of the Request object MUST contain the capabilities urn:ietf:params:jmap:mdn and urn:ietf:params:jmap:mail'. handle_mdn_send (crate-jmap-mail-server/src/mdn.rs) never inspects the 'using' array passed in the request. The dispatcher infrastructure (check_known_capabilities) only validates that URIs are known, not that required URIs are present. No code path enforces the MUST. Fix: handle_mdn_send must receive the JmapRequest::using slice and reject with invalidArguments if either URI is absent.
title: MDN/send: missing using-contains-both check
